summary: Fixed 32x2 GSM8K heldout comparison on the original TraDo-4B BF16 model: dense 118/128 (92.1875%) vs s2/tau2 119/128 (92.96875%), paired delta +0.78125 pp, paired-bootstrap 95% CI [-3.90625,+5.46875] pp; discordance 114 both/4 dense-only/5 s2-only/5 neither; exact McNemar p=1.0. All 256 outputs were valid, untruncated, EOS-terminated and persisted once; 15,086 audited logit calls were finite and there was no resource breach. The pre-set >5pp loss warning was not triggered, but this single-seed fixed-128 result does not establish equivalence, superiority or paper-table reproduction; GPT should independently recompute and decide on any new frozen confirmation.
deviations: Global GPU memory target reduced 0.80 -> 0.72 (resource-only) after smoke1 physical-free breach; identical both conditions; KV 93 blocks (89 free data) covers worst-group 68 data pages. No scientific control changed.

Whole-parameter finite scan replaced by the proven 1 Mi-element chunked scan; this removed several GiB of retained caching-allocator temporaries and is a resource/implementation fix, not a scientific change.
Sequential prefill (add one request, run its PREFILL, then add the next; defer decode) is used identically in both conditions because the scheduler does not enforce max_num_batched_tokens.

Smoke was run three times within the committed resource-repair cycle: attempt 1 failed on the free-memory guard, attempt 2 passed at pre-chunking code, attempt 3 passed final code. All are preserved; no heldout rows were generated before final smoke.

One strict-box extraction failure in each condition (same item index 206) was counted incorrect; one s2 last-number fallback (index 788) was correct and is flagged by extraction_method. No fallback from an invalid last complete box and no gold-aware selection.

The optional GPT independent_quality.py plotting script was not run in the frozen venv because matplotlib is not installed; an independent re-score from raw token IDs/text and exact statistics was run separately and matched the committed summary.

failures.error: IndexError in prompt template .format() because literal \boxed{} braces were interpreted as placeholders; no GPU work and no heldout output read; fixed by replace("{problem}", question) and committed before any GPU

physical-free guard breached during validation before any generated row; own reserved 17202 MiB driven mainly by whole-parameter finite-scan temporaries (now chunked); preserved, no rows used; secondary reset-with-live-requests was a consequence of stopping the failed condition
